card.title: 冻结实验输入并公平执行基线和候选
actions: 在任何候选运行前固定问题、基线、版本、指标、预算/停止条件和样本hash。
相同输入分别运行基线与候选，保留stdout/stderr/exit/原始测量；候选只能改隔离工作区。
运行12条冻结smoke及零样本/改hash/越权负例；统计实现接入实际持久化报告。
deliverables: 实验报告包含可复算计数、版本和所有失败样本。
反例：删除失败样本、补造缺失指标或运行后更改通过门均失败。
limits: 只改本卡登记范围；共享合同/锁/迁移序号由对应owner串行整合。
模式DEVELOPMENT/FIXTURE/资格样机与正式LIVE分别记录；子卡完成不签收整个WBS或父用例。
同输入同失败最多自动重试2次；无新证据3轮延期，禁止换Goal/窗口重置。
不改冻结门槛、旧回执或未知费用；资源缺失只阻塞依赖该资源的步骤。

declared_selector_measured_refusal.result: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, exit 3, registry_spec v2.0 (resolved through the legacy fallback because the key is absent from execution/v2.4/commands.json)
declared_selector_measured_refusal.reason: legacy selectors route W10 through the gate ids W10-G01/W10-G02 and the cases A07/C05, never through a slice id of the form W10-0N; so the declared route cannot answer this card

handler_writability.scope_note: the card may write internal/domain/experiment*.go, adapters/evaluation/** and tests/experiments/**; ops/ci/experiments.py belongs to none of them, so the card cannot make the declared handler emit its ids either

frozen_smoke_set.note: no smoke- id found in the scanned files; the card's '12 frozen smoke' number has no program naming it today (measured by absence in those paths only, not by a repo-wide search)

what_this_card_must_still_produce: a W1001-* assertion roster covering: inputs frozen before any candidate runs (question, baseline, versions, metrics, budget/stop conditions, sample hashes); baseline and candidate run on identical input with stdout/stderr/exit/raw measurements retained; the candidate confined to an isolated workspace; the six verdict classes and three dispositions distinguished; the frozen smoke set plus the zero-sample, changed-hash and over-reach negatives; statistics computed from the persisted report
a handler inside tests/experiments/** plus a new registry key, because the declared route cannot answer a card id and its legacy handler is outside this card's scope
an explicit measured statement about the declared selector, served or not
open_questions_this_inventory_cannot_ans: whether the existing experiments code already persists a recomputable report (deliverable 1) or only an in-memory result - that needs a run against a real project state, not a grep
who owns adding W10-01 to the legacy route, since ops/ci/experiments.py is not this card's to edit
